subject: general
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e512ada68b84c8df06018d6295641323d0c36ba2c7b09a8790a7b8c114f50f9f.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is :

1) All the elements shift in the clockwise direction.

2) The ' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0f6069674a4fb59334b005e8b4d56c9c5e4b5679abd0339bf13842995a0b6e99.png] ' and ' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4915c0aaa79dcc107a6a7936c3c854f6ea821a6650c72f4ee5af979c8121d57f.png] ' elements rotate clockwise.

3) The ' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0d0767ca982bfc5aececeb788516cecbdc82fbd524559d67caae48bc3c777842.png] ' and ' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4b3da6cff69030572e78871b79938a1c25965899227b0feb04ff1996c19abed5.png] ' elements rotate anticlockwise.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e285f1c53135034f02955bd2f569cc22d5f5d6604106aba3720426c56952363c.png] 

Thus, the final series is :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3a43da878a74608309acb7b098ba9bf9495aea2938ef5922c46703c521cac611.png] 

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
